window.confirm -> await window.confirmAsync in all six delete handlers (all already async).
URL.createObjectURL -> objectUrl(file); URL.revokeObjectURL calls dropped (no-op for a file uri).

LandingPageManagement restaurant-picker avatar: the web hid the via e.target.style.display on error and revealed a gradient initial behind it; ported as a plain conditional - image when profileImageUrl exists, else an expo-linear-gradient swatch with the initial. bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-400 to-blue-600 -> <LinearGradient colors={['#60a5fa','#2563eb']}>.
Recommended-restaurants row was a <label> wrapping a Checkbox; ported as a pressable Div with the same onClick toggle (web's Label primitive is a Text and cannot host the checkbox row).
Explore-More icon upload was a <label htmlFor> over a hidden file input; ported as a Button with the same classes that opens the picker.
overflow-y-auto containers -> ScrollDiv (recommended-restaurant list, restaurant-picker modal list); overflow-x-auto tab rows -> HScroll (4 rows across the two pages).
LandingPageSettings: FileReader/data-URL image preview -> pickImage + objectUrl(file) stored in the same state field; handleImageUpload signature changed from (e, setter, field) to (setter, field).

No color-picker primitive for <input type="color"> (built a swatch + hex field in-page, per the guide).

routes: src/app/taxi/admin/driver-import/create/index.jsx -> drivers/DriverImportCreate (the admin-nested copy of the web route; taxi-core owns /taxi/driver-import/create)
deviations: driverImportSchema readWorkbook: the web does XLSX.read(await file.arrayBuffer()); a picked file here has no arrayBuffer, so pickSpreadsheet() (lib/files) parses the workbook and the pages attach it as file.workbook, which readWorkbook now uses. DriverBulkUpload / DriverImportCreate: hidden <input type=file> + drag-and-drop handlers -> pickSpreadsheet() buttons. The drag state (dragActive) is dead on a touch device, so the state and its conditional classes were dropped (the inactive styling is kept).
DriverBulkUpload row Download: Blob + URL.createObjectURL + <a download> -> expo-file-system File(uri).base64() + saveBase64File(file.name, ...) (share sheet), same file name and bytes.

DriverBulkUpload 'Select Files' navigated to '/driver-import/create' on the web, which is not a route of the taxi app (the real routes are /taxi/driver-import/create and /taxi/admin/driver-import/create); pointed it at /taxi/driver-import/create so the button works.

DriverList / PendingDrivers row action menu: createPortal into document.body with a getBoundingClientRect-computed fixed position -> one <Overlay> (Modal) holding the same 220px menu panel as a centred card, closed by backdrop tap and hardware back. The Escape/scroll/resize listeners that closed it on the web were removed (no such events here).

PendingDrivers: the menu's Approve/Edit/View/Delete items now closeMenu() before handleAction (the web leaves the portal open behind the page); as a modal it has to close, the driver id is captured first.

DriverList/PendingDrivers/DriverAudit/DriverDeleteRequests/DriverDetails tables: dropped the overflow-x-auto (and min-w-[720px]) wrappers and gave each Table explicit cols widths so it scrolls sideways like the web.
DriverAudit document row: the Maximize2 overlay button was opacity-0 until hover and had no onClick, so it is unreachable on touch; removed it and kept the preview Img.
DriverAudit/DriverDeleteRequests/DriverList/PendingDrivers/DriverDetails: window.confirm -> await window.confirmAsync in async handlers.

CreateDriver: FileReader.readAsDataURL -> expo-file-system File(uri).base64() wrapped as a data: URL, because the payload posts the document/profile image as a data URL. The Gallery/Camera overlay file inputs became Buttons calling pickImage() / pickImage({ camera: true }); the profile-photo Label became a Button opening the gallery picker.

CreateDriver root: the web's bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,#f6efe4,#fcfaf6,#ffffff)] and inline fontFamily 'Plus Jakarta Sans' became a solid bg-[#fcfaf6] and no inline family (the Taxi layout already sets Inter, and neither font is bundled).
EditDriver profile photo: FileReader data URL -> objectUrl(picked file) for the preview (the web never submits this preview), and the transparent file input became a Button.

DriverDetails map: @react-google-maps/api GoogleMap/MarkerF -> components/maps GMap+Marker; center+zoom 13 became initialRegion with 0.05 deltas; the google.maps.Size/Point scaled icon became the Marker's image source ({ uri } for a server URL, the required asset otherwise) with a centre anchor; mapTypeControl/fullscreenControl have no react-native-maps equivalent, zoom controls stay on.

DriverDetails charts: the hand-rolled react-native-svg charts keep the same maths/colours; className on <Svg> became width="100%" height="100%" plus an absolute-fill style for the two overlay charts. react-native-svg's Polyline was aliased to SvgPolyline to avoid clashing with maps' Polyline.
kitGaps: lib/files has no 'read a picked file as a data URL' helper (the web's FileReader.readAsDataURL) and no way to re-share a picked local file; both pages fall back to expo-file-system's File(uri).base64().
lib/files pickSpreadsheet returns { file, workbook } as separate values, so a schema helper that takes only a File (as the web's does) must be reshaped to receive the workbook.
components/web Overlay has no anchored/popover mode, so a row-anchored dropdown can only be a centred modal panel.
components/maps GMap takes initialRegion only (no center+zoom) and exposes no map-type / fullscreen controls.
notes: npx eslint over src/taxi/modules/admin/pages/drivers, src/taxi/modules/driver and the route files: 0 errors, 55 warnings (all inherited web effect patterns: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect and exhaustive-deps).

deviations: GeneralSettings: setLiveFavicon() (document.head <link rel=icon> swapping, URL.createObjectURL/Blob) removed - a browser tab favicon has no native equivalent; the favicon data URL is still prepared and saved to the API unchanged.

GeneralSettings: the effect writing --admin-theme-color / --landing-theme-color / --admin-sidebar-text-color onto document.documentElement removed - no CSS custom properties in RN; the colour values still round-trip through the form and the PATCH payload.

GeneralSettings: favicon resize used a 64x64 <canvas>; replaced with expo-image-manipulator resize({64,64}) + PNG save + base64 -> the same data: URL shape. Logo upload reads the picked file with expo-file-system File().base64() instead of FileReader.
GeneralSettings: <input type=color> dropped (no native colour picker); the hex text Input + the colour swatch remain, and the helper text now says 'Type a hex color.'

NotificationChannels: the web's custom grid-cols-[1fr,140px,140px,280px] pseudo-table (min-w-[1000px] inside overflow-x-auto) became an HScroll with a 1000px-wide flex row layout, same column widths.

PaymentGateways / SMSGateways / NotificationChannels / PaymentMethods: the 'sr-only peer' + peer-checked CSS toggles became the kit <Switch>, keeping each toggle's checked colour (yellow-400 / indigo-600 / emerald-600 / emerald-500).

WithdrawalRequestDetail: backdrop-blur-sm dropped (not supported).
MailSettings: the literal quotes in the '"From" Email Address' / '"From" Name' labels written as " to satisfy react/no-unescaped-entities (renders identically).
kitGaps: No helper for 'resize an image to an exact NxN PNG data URL' (the web's canvas favicon resize); written inline in GeneralSettings with expo-image-manipulator.
No kit toggle-switch shaped like the web's 'sr-only peer' pattern - the codemod leaves the peer markup, which renders as a dead grey pill; used shadcn <Switch> with a colour override instead.

deviations: Google Maps Autocomplete (Airport, ZoneManagement, CreatePackagePrice): no Places widget in RN. New helper price-management/PlaceSearchField.jsx runs geocodeAPI.textSearch, lists matches and hands onPlace an object shaped like Autocomplete.getPlace() (name, formatted_address, address_components, geometry.location.lat()/lng()), so each page's place handler keeps the web's body.

Airport boundary drawing: Google DrawingManager's polygon tool became a 'Draw Boundary' toggle; while on, each map tap appends a vertex (EditablePolygon vertices are draggable, tapping one removes it). Same boundary_coordinates payload. The help text on the page was reworded to match.

Airport map/marker: GoogleMap+MarkerF -> GMap + draggable Marker (pinColor #4f46e5 instead of the google.maps CIRCLE symbol); map.panTo/setZoom -> animateToRegion; MAP_CONTAINER_STYLE dropped (GMap is sized by className). Map height 600px -> 420px so it fits a phone with the search row above it.

ZoneManagement drawing: DrawingManager (polygon + circle modes) became the form's existing Boundary Shape buttons driving map taps - polygon mode appends/drag-edits vertices, circle mode places the centre with the radius taken from the existing radius field. Map height 620px -> 460px.
ZoneManagement fitMapToPaths: google.maps.LatLngBounds + map.fitBounds(bounds, 40) -> regionFor(points) + animateToRegion.

ZoneManagement web bug fixed: fetchData declared zoneData with const inside the `if (zoneRes)` block and read it again in the edit branch - a ReferenceError that sent every edit-mode load into the catch and showed 'Zone data could not be loaded.'. zoneData is now function-scoped so the edit lookup runs (the same thing the page's [id, zones] effect already does).

VehicleType image pickers: two <input type=file accept=image/*> became pickImage() from lib/files; FileReader.readAsDataURL became expo-file-system File(uri).base64() wrapped in the same data: URL, so formData.image / map_icon and the save payload are unchanged.
Serif headings (SetPackagePrices, SetPrices x2, SurgePricing, CreatePackagePrice): fontFamily '"Times New Roman", Times, serif' is not a bundled face; set to 'Playfair', the kit's bundled serif.

Tables: the web's overflow-x-auto wrappers dropped and cols widths set (Table scrolls sideways itself) - SetPackagePrices, Airport, ServiceLocation, SetPrices, VehicleType, ZoneManagement, RentalPackageTypes.

DriverIncentive's purely decorative `fixed bottom-10 right-10` badge (no handler) now sits right-aligned at the end of the scrolling page instead of pinned over it.
Two decorative near-white gradients (VehicleType user-card preview, ServiceLocation info card) set to bg-white, since the tw bridge drops gradients and both cards would otherwise be transparent.

No helper for 'read a picked file as a data URL' (the FileReader.readAsDataURL pattern) in lib/files - VehicleType uses expo-file-system File().base64() directly.

BookingInvoice: window.print() + the @media print rules that showed only #hotel-invoice became printHtml(invoiceHtml(invoice)) — the same fields, order and formatting rebuilt as an HTML document for the system print / save-as-PDF sheet.

CSV exports (users / bookings / partners / properties): Blob + <a download> -> saveTextFile with the same filename, headers and row values.

Horizontal tab strips (AdminUserDetail, AdminPartnerDetail, AdminHotelDetail) and the RoomRatesManager availability day strips are HScroll instead of overflow-x-auto.
Two apostrophe-bearing strings moved into JS string expressions to satisfy react/no-unescaped-entities; the rendered text is unchanged.
